scope: observed command catalogue, not capability or creative acceptance

commands.label: New Artboard
commands.params: {x?, y?, width?, height?, name?} (default: right of the last)

commands.label: Move Artboard
commands.params: {index, dx, dy, moveArt?: bool} move an artboard (and the unlocked art fully inside it)

commands.label: Convert to Artboards
commands.params: {} turn each selected object's bounds into a new artboard (the objects are removed) → {artboards}

commands.label: Rearrange All Artboards…
commands.params: {columns?: n (2), spacing?: pt (20), byColumn?: false, moveArtwork?: true} lay artboards out in a grid

commands.label: Duplicate Artboard
commands.params: {index} copy placed right of the last artboard
